cards.text:
TD09/001EN
Eradicator, Vowing Sword Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Narukami｜ Grade 3｜ Power 11000｜ Shield -
[AUTO][Limit-Break 4](This ability is active if you have four or more damage):When a <Narukami> rides this unit, choose one of your opponent's rear-guards in the front row, retire it, and choose your vanguard, and that unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, if the number of cards in your opponent's damage zone is three or more, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of that battle.
[CONT](VC/RC):Lord (If you have a unit without a same clan as this unit, this unit cannot attack)
